effects.text: Become Tiny for 1 round. All attacks against you miss. You can't deal damage or heal allies.

description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

Reaction (1 scrap): When attacked, become Tiny, 1 round. All attacks against you miss. You can't deal damage or heal allies.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): You have advantage on non-STR saves while Tiny.

Passive: You can choose to be your size or 1 size smaller (this choice lasts until your next Safe Rest).

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Elixir S (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Elixir S" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] Resolve the triggering attack as a miss and track Tiny for 1 round.
